page_title: VER 0-5 ATA | Verona v Atalanta 08/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Mathis Lambourde (Verona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Verona hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
84' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
82' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Davide Zappacosta and he is replaced by Marco Palestra (Atalanta).
81' Verona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' What was Ibrahim Sulemana (Atalanta) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
79' A substitution has been made. Tomas Suslov is replaced by Mathis Lambourde (Verona).
79' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies just over the crossbar.
77' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and signals a foul after Stefan Posch (Atalanta) brought his opponent down.
76' Verona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) zig-zags his way into the box and fires the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
74' 38:62 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
73' Verona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
72' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Marten de Roon will be replaced by Ibrahim Sulemana (Atalanta).
71' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
69' It will be a substitution. Nicolas Valentini (Verona) is ready to enter the pitch as Flavius Daniliuc walks off.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Verona.
67' Some great controlled play and passing from Atalanta. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
62' Paolo Zanetti has decided to make a change. Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) replaces Antoine Bernede.
62' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Domagoj Bradaric is replaced by Daniel Oyegoke (Verona).
62' The substitution is prepared. Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Amin Sarr.
61' The corner from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is intercepted by the defence.
60' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
59' That's the end of the game for Ederson, who is replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
59' Here is a change. Berat Djimsiti is going off and Gian Piero Gasperini gives the last tactical orders to Rafael Toloi (Atalanta).
59' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) latches onto the ball in the penalty box and takes a first-time effort that goes a couple of yards over the crossbar.
56' 0 - 5 It's 0:5! Marten de Roon feeds Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
55' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
54' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:6.
51' Antoine Bernede (Verona) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
51' Atalanta players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.

50' Amin Sarr (Verona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simone Sozza with no other option than to blow for a foul.
48' Some neat passing and movement from Verona as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) comes off for Marco Brescianini.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Simone Sozza sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Wait! Referee Simone Sozza has indicated he is going to review the Atalanta goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
44' 0 - 4 Goal! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 0:4.
43' Stefan Posch (Atalanta) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the right post.
42' The referee gives a yellow card to Daniele Ghilardi (Verona).
40' Atalanta are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
39' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

37' 0 - 3 Ederson (Atalanta) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Lorenzo Montipo is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 0:3.
36' One of the players from Verona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

35' A neat pass is well received by Stefan Posch (Atalanta), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot.
34' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
33' Cheikh Niasse (Verona) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
32' A pass by Amin Sarr (Verona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
30' A spell of possession for Verona in an attempt to control the game.
25' 0 - 2 Goal! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
24' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.
21' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the right post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
20' Amin Sarr (Verona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
20' Ederson (Atalanta) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' Some patient build-up play from Verona as they look to unlock the defence.

17' What a save from Lorenzo Montipo! Isak Hien (Atalanta) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.

16' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
16' The referee gives a yellow card to Cheikh Niasse (Verona) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
15' The ball goes out of play and Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
15' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
14' Ederson (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
11' Verona keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
9' That was close by Ederson (Atalanta)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
7' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
5' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar.
4' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Domagoj Bradaric (Verona).
2' Verona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Atalanta will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Simone Sozza.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
